skill.summary: Generate secure passwords via the AceToolz API. No passwords are stored — generated and returned in real-time.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Switched password generation from web_fetch to exec-based API calls for improved reliability.
- Clarified that no passwords are stored; all are generated and returned in real-time.
- Removed fallback mechanism and web_fetch instructions; now always uses exec for both Windows and macOS/Linux.
- Updated error handling and documentation for API unreachable scenarios.
